user.title: WOOW Serial
user.description: What do you want to add?

menu_options.external: External device bound from another integration (e.g. HA-WF485-V3)
menu_options.hub: Admin panel (monitor, devices and send log in the sidebar)

local.title: Add a port
local.description: Pick the RS485 / RS232 port to add. Ports that are already added are not listed.

serial.title: Serial port {port}
serial.description: Driver: {driver}. The line settings must match the device on the other end.

data.name: Name
data.loop_flush: Flush through internal loopback on open

data_description.frame_gap_ms: Silence that ends a received frame. 0 = automatic (24 character times, at least 20 ms; 25 ms at 9600 baud).
data_description.echo_filter: Half-duplex RS485 hears what it sends; drop that copy.
data_description.loop_flush: On open, push one byte round the UART's internal loopback so stale FIFO bytes never reach the wire.
data_description.line_ending: Appended to text sent with the Send text entity or the text field of the service.

external.title: External device
external.description: Pick the device that carries the RS485 / RS232 line. An HA-WF485-V3 fills the next page in by itself. Leave it empty to choose the entities by hand.

external_bind.title: Bind the external port
external_bind.description: Home Assistant sends by writing the bytes into the send entity, and treats every new value of the receive entity as a received frame.

data_description.tx_entity: A text entity that transmits what is written into it (HA-WF485-V3: HEX data TX).
data_description.rx_entity: An entity that shows each received frame (HA-WF485-V3: uart_net_hex).
data_description.idle_values: Comma-separated values that mean no data (HA-WF485-V3: IDLE).
data_description.status_entity: When this reads off, the port is shown as unavailable.

error.cannot_open: Cannot open the port (missing or in use).
error.same_entity: Sending and receiving need two different entities.

abort.no_ports: No free RS485 / RS232 port found.

data.loop_flush: Flush through internal loopback on open

data_description.frame_gap_ms: Silence that ends a received frame. 0 = automatic.
data_description.idle_values: Comma-separated values that mean no data (HA-WF485-V3: IDLE).

error.same_entity: Sending and receiving need two different entities.

send.name: Send (serial)
send.description: Send bytes or text on a port, optionally waiting for the reply frame (returned when a response is requested). Add return_response: true to get the result.

config_entry_id.name: Port (entry)
config_entry_id.description: The port's config entry. Give this or `port`.

port.name: Port
port.description: Port name (e.g. RS485-1), device path (/dev/ttySC0) or config entry id, as list_ports returns them.

text.name: Text
text.description: Text with \r \n \xHH escapes; the port's line ending is appended.

expect.name: Expected reply
expect.description: Wait for the first frame matching this receive pattern (HEX with ?? and *, or a regular expression for text) and skip the others, e.g. polls of other devices on the line. Waits wait_ms, 2000 ms if not given; the reply's captures are returned.

wait_ms.name: Wait for reply
wait_ms.description: 0 = do not wait. Otherwise return the next received frame (or timeout).

note.name: Note
note.description: Why this is done, in a sentence. Shown to people in the panel's activity log.

describe.name: Describe
describe.description: Returns how to use this integration: workflow, device types and actions, the device definition fields, command template and receive pattern syntax, checksums, events, current ports, templates and devices. Call this first. Call it with return_response: true.

list_ports.name: List ports
list_ports.description: Returns every port (on-board UARTs and bound external devices) with its id, name, kind, line settings, availability and counters. Call it with return_response: true.

get_monitor.name: Get monitor
get_monitor.description: Returns the frames the ports have heard, grouped by sender (header / address bytes), with counts, readable text and the checksum each group agrees on. Call it with return_response: true.

port.name: Port
port.description: Port name (e.g. RS485-1), device path (/dev/ttySC0) or config entry id, as list_ports returns them.

limit.name: Groups
limit.description: How many groups to return, most recently heard first.

include_hidden.name: Include hidden
include_hidden.description: Also return groups hidden in the panel.

get_send_log.name: Get send log
get_send_log.description: Returns what Home Assistant sent: content, origin (service, entity, panel, device), count, whether the equipment answered (reply and delay) and which other ports heard it. Call it with return_response: true.

port.name: Port
port.description: Port name (e.g. RS485-1), device path (/dev/ttySC0) or config entry id, as list_ports returns them.

limit.name: Limit
limit.description: How many entries to return, newest first.

listen.name: Listen
listen.description: Waits for the next frame a port hears (not one Home Assistant sent) and returns it: ask the person to press the remote or keypad button first. Call it with return_response: true.

port.name: Port
port.description: Port name (e.g. RS485-1), device path (/dev/ttySC0) or config entry id, as list_ports returns them.

timeout.name: Timeout
timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the frame.

list_devices.name: List devices
list_devices.description: Returns the managed devices with their full definition, current state and entity ids. Call it with return_response: true.

port.name: Port
port.description: Port name (e.g. RS485-1), device path (/dev/ttySC0) or config entry id, as list_ports returns them.

type.name: Type
type.description: Only devices / templates of this type.

get_device.name: Get device
get_device.description: Returns one managed device: definition, state, entity ids and the actions other buttons may bind to it. Call it with return_response: true.

device.name: Device
device.description: Device name or id, as list_devices returns them.

preview_command.name: Preview command
preview_command.description: Returns the bytes a command template sends with these parameters and value, or a coded error explaining why it cannot. Call it with return_response: true.

payload.name: Template
payload.description: Command template as in a device definition, HEX or text: the example shows the syntax, describe explains it.

format.name: Format
format.description: hex (bytes) or text (ASCII with escapes / regular expression).

params.name: Parameters
params.description: Device parameters: an object of name and value (HEX for HEX templates, text for text ones), as in the example.

value.name: Value
value.description: The value a template's value field takes, in device units.

test_pattern.name: Test pattern
test_pattern.description: Tries a receive pattern on the frames the monitor holds for a port; returns the frames that match and what each capture reads. Call it with return_response: true.

pattern.name: Pattern
pattern.description: Receive pattern as in a device definition (HEX, or a regular expression for text): the example shows the syntax.

port.name: Port
port.description: Port name (e.g. RS485-1), device path (/dev/ttySC0) or config entry id, as list_ports returns them.

format.name: Format
format.description: hex (bytes) or text (ASCII with escapes / regular expression).

params.name: Parameters
params.description: Device parameters: an object of name and value (HEX for HEX templates, text for text ones), as in the example.

list_templates.name: List templates
list_templates.description: Returns the built-in and local device templates: id, brand, model, type, required line settings, parameters, commands and buttons. Call it with return_response: true.

type.name: Type
type.description: Only devices / templates of this type.

get_activity.name: Get activity
get_activity.description: Returns the activity log: what was changed or sent, by whom (service, panel, entity), when, with the note given. Call it with return_response: true.

limit.name: Limit
limit.description: How many entries to return, newest first.

device.name: Device
device.description: Device name or id, as list_devices returns them.

save_device.name: Save device
save_device.description: Creates or replaces a managed device from a full definition (see describe). Names may stand for ids: the port, command names in actions / options / poll_command, a button's target device. Returns the saved device, or a coded error to fix and resend. Needs an admin user. Add return_response: true to get the result.

device.name: Device
device.description: The device definition object: name, type, port (or port_id), params, commands, actions, options, rules, sensors, buttons, ranges, poll_command, poll_interval.

replace.name: Replace same name
replace.description: Saving a device whose name already exists updates that device instead of failing.

note.name: Note
note.description: Why this is done, in a sentence. Shown to people in the panel's activity log.

create_from_template.name: Create from template
create_from_template.description: Creates a managed device from a built-in or local template on a port, filling in its parameters (usually the device address). Returns the device and the line settings the equipment expects. Needs an admin user. Add return_response: true to get the result.

port.name: Port
port.description: Port name (e.g. RS485-1), device path (/dev/ttySC0) or config entry id, as list_ports returns them.

name.name: Name
name.description: Device name; the template's name when empty.

params.name: Parameters
params.description: The template's parameters, usually the device address: an object of name and value as in the example. list_templates shows each template's parameters.

note.name: Note
note.description: Why this is done, in a sentence. Shown to people in the panel's activity log.

delete_device.name: Delete device
delete_device.description: Deletes a managed device and its entities. Needs an admin user. Add return_response: true to get the result.

device.name: Device
device.description: Device name or id, as list_devices returns them.

note.name: Note
note.description: Why this is done, in a sentence. Shown to people in the panel's activity log.

run_command.name: Run command
run_command.description: Sends one command of a managed device (all its repeats); returns what was sent and the reply when the command waits for one. Add return_response: true to get the result.

device.name: Device
device.description: Device name or id, as list_devices returns them.

value.name: Value
value.description: The value for commands that take one, in device units.

note.name: Note
note.description: Why this is done, in a sentence. Shown to people in the panel's activity log.

learn_command.name: Learn command
learn_command.description: Listens on the device's port and adds the next frame heard as a new command of the device (ask the person to press the original remote first). Returns the device and what was heard. Needs an admin user. Add return_response: true to get the result.

device.name: Device
device.description: Device name or id, as list_devices returns them.

timeout.name: Timeout
timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the frame.

note.name: Note
note.description: Why this is done, in a sentence. Shown to people in the panel's activity log.

learn_button.name: Learn button
learn_button.description: Listens on a keypad's port and adds the next frame heard as a new button (ask the person to press the physical button first). Returns the keypad and what was heard. Needs an admin user. Add return_response: true to get the result.

timeout.name: Timeout
timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the frame.

note.name: Note
note.description: Why this is done, in a sentence. Shown to people in the panel's activity log.

not_loaded.message: {entry} is not a loaded WOOW Serial port.

too_long.message: {name}: too much data; the bound entity takes at most {limit} characters.

no_payload.message: Nothing to send: give hex or text.

port_missing.message: {name}: its port is not available right now.

not_a_port.message: {name} is the admin panel, not a port.

panel_not_loaded.message: The WOOW Serial admin entry is not loaded; add it under Settings › Devices & services.

no_port.message: Name the port: give `port` (e.g. RS485-1) or `config_entry_id`.

invalid_device.message: The device definition is not valid ({code}): {detail}
